 Torino vs Monza Torino Monza Serie A Follow the seventh round of Serie A live with us.
 Serie A, matchday 7 
 Torino-Monza 0-0 
 Goalscorers: 
 Torino and Monza meet at 20:45 at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino in an early fixture in the seventh round of Serie A, with both teams in buoyant mood. 
 Ignazio Abate's Torino head into the match with two straight wins. After a 2-1 victory over Udinese, they swept aside Parma 3-0 at the Tardini, with Giovanni Simeone the standout performer thanks to a brace and a display that finally lived up to expectations. 
 For former Torino man Ivan Juric's Monza, Gustavo Varela has provided plenty to smile about: the forward has scored eight goals in seven matches across Serie A and the Coppa Italia, including a brace in the 4-0 win over Cagliari in the last round.
